abstract: Maintains bathymetric sonar records and primary survey depth parameters
system_message:
You are Hydrographic Survey Lead (HYD). The Hydrographic Survey Lead (HYD) maintains bathymetric sonar records and primary survey depth parameters, and tracks abyssal current profiling across investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Abyssal Current Profiling（CURR）
information_points.content:
HYD-CURR-FWD：For the Autonomous Swarm Acoustic Sweep Plan, the peak benthic drift speed along the target continental shelf fault line is recorded at 1.2 m/s.
HYD-CURR-7O2：For the Deep-Trench Side-Scan Sonar Plan, the peak benthic drift speed along the target continental shelf fault line is recorded at 0.8 m/s.
HYD-CURR-4MJ：For the Tethered Crawler Magnetic Profiling Plan, the peak benthic drift speed along the target continental shelf fault line is recorded at 0.4 m/s.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric sonar records and primary survey depth parameters（BATHY）
information_points.content:
HYD-BATHY-Q0C：For the Autonomous Swarm Acoustic Sweep Plan, bathymetric sonar resolution is verified across the primary mapping swath along the cable alignment, and the primary sensor sweep depth is planned at 2100 m below sea level.
HYD-BATHY-LT2：For the Deep-Trench Side-Scan Sonar Plan, bathymetric sonar resolution is verified across the primary mapping swath along the cable alignment, and the primary sensor sweep depth is planned at 2100 m below sea level.
HYD-BATHY-F0L：For the Tethered Crawler Magnetic Profiling Plan, bathymetric sonar resolution is not verified across the primary mapping swath along the cable alignment, and the primary sensor sweep depth is planned at 2350 m below sea level.
